ko.title: NFL 경기 중 방영되는 캠페인 스타일의 광고: 백악관의 트럼프 홍보가 논란이 되는 이유

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: 일요일에 경기를 시청하는 미식축구 팬들은 트럭 광고와 맥주 광고라는 평소의 조합을 넘어선 무언가에 직면했습니다. 그것은 바로 NFL 중계와 네트워크 뉴스 프로그램 도중 방영되는, 트럼프 대통령과 행정부의 실적을 홍보하는 세련된 광고 영상입니다.

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: 백악관은 이 광고들이 합법적인 대국민 소통이라고 옹호했습니다.

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 그것이 선거 유세 광고처럼 보이고 느껴진다고 말하며, 특히 중간선거가 불과 몇 주 앞으로 다가온 상황에서 그 차이가 중요하다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## 논란이 되는 내용

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: 이번 논쟁은 단순한 질문에 집중되어 있습니다. 정부의 메시지 전달은 언제 대중에게 정보를 제공하는 것을 멈추고 정치인을 홍보하기 시작할까요?

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **백악관의 입장:** 당국자들은 이 광고가 미국 대중에게 정책과 성과를 설명하는 것이며, 양당의 대통령들은 유권자들과 소통하기 위해 항상 집무실의 플랫폼을 이용해 왔다고 말합니다.

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **비평가들의 입장:** 감시 단체, 일부 법학자, 정치적 반대파들은 이 광고가 대통령 개인을 강조하고, 선거 유세의 시각적 언어를 사용하며, 가장 비싸고 시청률이 높은 시간대에 방영된다고 말합니다. 그들의 관점에서 이는 공공 정보라기보다는 정치적 설득에 가깝습니다.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: 양측은 한 가지 점에 대해서는 동의합니다. 바로 이 광고가 매우 큰 시청자층에 도달한다는 점입니다.

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: NFL 경기는 한 번에 수천만 명의 시청자를 끌어모으는 몇 안 되는 라이브 이벤트 중 하나이며, 이것이 모든 종류의 광고주들이 그 시간대에 프리미엄을 지불하는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## 납세자 자금으로 지원되는 메시지에 대한 규칙

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: 연방 법률과 오랜 지침은 대중과 소통하는 데 정부 자금을 어떻게 사용할 수 있는지에 대해 제한을 두고 있습니다.

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: 이 세부 사항들은 정치적 논쟁에서 종종 잘못 인용되기 때문에 이해할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **홍보 및 선전 제한.** 의회는 수십 년 동안 의회의 승인을 받지 않은 "홍보 또는 선전" 목적의 연방 기금 사용을 금지하는 조항을 예산안에 붙여왔습니다.

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: 이러한 문제를 검토하는 회계감사원(GAO)은 이를 일반적으로 은밀한 선전, 순수하게 당파적인 메시지, 그리고 공직자들의 자기 미화를 다루는 것으로 해석해 왔습니다.

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **해치법.** 이 법은 대부분의 연방 공무원의 정치 활동을 제한합니다.

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: 대통령과 부통령은 핵심 조항에서 대부분 면제되므로, 이 법은 대통령직 자체보다는 개별 직원들에게 더 직접적으로 적용됩니다.

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: 그러한 면제 조항은 백악관 소통을 둘러싼 집행 문제가 복잡한 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **합법적인 정부 정보.** 기관들은 프로그램, 혜택, 안전 정보 및 마감일에 대해 대중에게 알리는 것이 허용되며, 종종 요구되기도 합니다.

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: 공익 광고는 흔하며 대개 논란의 여지가 없습니다.

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: 회색 지대는 메시지가 프로그램이나 서비스보다는 지명된 공직자와 그의 개인적인 공로에 초점을 맞출 때 나타납니다.

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **누가 비용을 지불하느냐가 중요합니다.** 일부 광고는 납세자가 아니라 정치 위원회나 연합 외부 단체에 의해 자금이 지원될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: 그렇다면 선거 자금 및 공개 규칙은 적용되겠지만, 예산 제약은 동일하게 적용되지 않을 것입니다.

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: 자금 출처를 파악하는 것은 모든 합법적인 검토의 첫 번째 단계인 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## 선을 긋기 어려운 이유

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: 검토자들은 일반적으로 몇 가지 요인을 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **콘텐츠:** 광고가 프로그램을 설명하고 이를 사용하는 방법을 알려주는지, 아니면 주로 특정인을 찬양하는지 여부

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **어조와 이미지:** 프레젠테이션이 정보 제공용인지, 아니면 선거 스타일의 음악, 슬로건, 상대방과의 대조를 사용하는지 여부

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **시기:** 광고가 선거에 임박하여 방영되는지, 그리고 후보자나 투표 용지의 선택 사항을 언급하는지 여부

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **배치:** 시청자층이 메시지의 유용성을 위해 타겟팅되었는지, 아니면 정치적 가치를 위해 타겟팅되었는지 여부

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **자금 조달:** 방송 시간과 제작 비용은 누가 지불했는가?

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: 단일 요인만으로는 결정적이지 않습니다.

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: 양당의 과거 행정부들도 옹호 성향의 정부 소통에 대한 불만에 직면해 왔으며, 집행은 역사적으로 제한적이었습니다.

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: GAO의 의견은 무게감을 가지지만 항상 처벌이 따르는 것은 아니며, 법원이 개입하는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 중간선거를 몇 주 앞둔 시점에서 이것이 의미하는 바

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.
segments.tr: 시기는 논란을 증폭시킵니다.

segments.src: Midterm elections determine control of Congress, and the president's approval and visibility tend to shape how voters feel about candidates from the president's party, even when the president is not on the ballot.
segments.tr: 중간선거는 의회의 통제권을 결정하며, 대통령이 투표용지에 없더라도 대통령의 지지도와 인지도 경향은 유권자들이 대통령 소속 정당의 후보자에 대해 느끼는 감정을 형성하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Supporters of the ads see a president speaking directly to the public and getting around media filters.
segments.tr: 광고 지지자들은 대통령이 대중에게 직접 이야기하고 미디어의 필터를 우회하는 것을 봅니다.

segments.src: Opponents see an advantage that challengers and rival parties cannot match, since a government communications operation is not bound by the same fundraising limits as a campaign.
segments.tr: 반대파들은 정부 소통 운영이 선거 캠페인과 동일한 모금 한도의 제약을 받지 않기 때문에, 도전자들과 라이벌 정당들이 맞출 수 없는 이점을 봅니다.

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: 실무적인 미디어 문제도 있습니다.

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: 방송사와 네트워크는 정치 및 이슈 광고 수용에 대한 자체 기준을 설정하며, 많은 이들이 논란이 되는 정치적 주제를 다루는 광고에 대해 추가적인 검토를 적용합니다.

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: 그러한 기준이 정부 지원 광고에 어떻게 적용되는지는 별도의 토론 주제입니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **자금 공개:** 서류 제출과 공공 기록을 통해 광고 비용을 지불한 사람이 명확해질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **감독 요청:** 의원들이나 감시 단체들은 GAO나 감찰관에게 지출 내역 검토를 요청할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **방송사의 결정:** 네트워크와 리그들은 이러한 광고를 어떻게 분류하는지 명확히 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **유권자의 반응:** 광고 방영 후의 여론조사는 그것이 여론을 바꾸는지, 아니면 단순히 선거철의 소음을 가중시키는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The White House says these ads inform the public.
segments.tr: 백악관은 이 광고들이 대중에게 정보를 제공한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Critics say they promote a politician at public expense.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 그것이 공적 자금으로 정치인을 홍보한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: 법은 양자 사이에 실질적인 구선을 긋고 있지만, 이를 적용하는 것은 종종 논란이 되는 콘텐츠, 자금 조달 및 시기의 세부 사항에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.
segments.tr: 스스로 판단하고자 하는 독자들은 광고가 실제로 무엇을 말하는지, 누가 비용을 지불했는지, 그리고 그것이 프로그램을 설명하는지 아니면 주로 개인을 홍보하는지 살펴볼 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로 작성되었으며 모든 측면에서 공개적으로 논의된 입장을 반영합니다.

segments.tr: 법적 조언이 아닙니다.*

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## 关于纳税人资助的信息发布的规则

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: 联邦法律和长期存在的指导方针限制了政府资金用于与公众沟通的方式。

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: 这些细节值得了解，因为它们在政治辩论中经常被错误表述。

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **宣传和游说限制。** 几十年来，国会在拨款法案中附加了条款，禁止将联邦资金用于未经国会授权的“宣传或游说”目的。

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: 负责审查此类问题的政府问责局（GAO）通常将其解释为涵盖隐蔽宣传、纯粹的党派信息以及官员的自我标榜。

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **哈奇法案。** 该法案限制了大多数联邦雇员的政治活动。

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: 它对个别雇员的限制比对总统本身的限制更直接，因为总统和副总统在很大程度上免受其核心条款的约束。

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: 这种豁免是白宫通信执法问题变得复杂的原因之一。

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **合法的政府信息。** 机构被允许、并且经常被要求向公众告知项目、福利、安全信息和截止日期。

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: 公共服务公告很常见，且大多没有争议。

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: 灰色地带出现在信息以某个具名官员及其个人政绩为核心，而不是以项目或服务为核心时。

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **资金来源很关键。** 其中一些广告可能由政治委员会或盟友外部团体资助，而不是由纳税人资助。

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: 如果是这样，拨款限制将不会以同样的方式适用，尽管竞选财务和披露规则依然适用。

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: 确定资金来源通常是任何合法审查的第一步。

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## 为什么界限很难划分

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: 审查人员通常会考虑以下几个因素：

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **内容：** 广告是描述了一个项目及其使用方法，还是主要在赞美某个人？

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **基调和意象：** 展示是 информационный (informational) 的，还是使用了竞选风格的音乐、口号并与对手进行对比？

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **时机：** 广告是在临近选举时播出的吗，是否提及了候选人或选票选择？

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **投放：** 受众是因为对信息有用而被定位，还是因为其政治价值？

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **资金：** 谁支付了播出时间和制作费用？

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: 没有任何单一因素是决定性的。

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: 两党过去的政府都曾面对关于倡导式政府沟通的投诉，历史上执法力度一直有限。

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: GAO 的意见很有分量，但它们并不总是伴随着处罚，法院也很少介入。

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 中期选举前几周意味着什么

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.
segments.tr: 时机放大了争议。

segments.src: Midterm elections determine control of Congress, and the president's approval and visibility tend to shape how voters feel about candidates from the president's party, even when the president is not on the ballot.
segments.tr: 中期选举决定了国会的控制权，即使总统不在选票上，总统的支持率和曝光度也往往会塑造选民对总统所在党派候选人的看法。

segments.src: Supporters of the ads see a president speaking directly to the public and getting around media filters.
segments.tr: 广告的支持者看到的是一位总统直接与公众对话并绕过媒体过滤。

segments.src: Opponents see an advantage that challengers and rival parties cannot match, since a government communications operation is not bound by the same fundraising limits as a campaign.
segments.tr: 反对者看到的是挑战者和竞争政党无法匹敌的优势，因为政府宣传运作不受竞选筹款限制的约束。

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: 这里还有一个实际的媒体问题。

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: 广播公司和电视网制定了接受政治和议题广告的自身标准，许多公司对涉及有争议政治话题的广告进行额外审查。

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: 这些标准如何应用于政府赞助的短片是一个独立讨论的点。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来关注什么

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **资金披露：** 申报文件和公共记录可能会澄清谁支付了广告费用。

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **监督请求：** 国会议员或监督团体可能会要求 GAO 或总检察长审查这项开支。

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **广播公司决定：** 电视网和联盟可以澄清他们如何分类这些广告。

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **选民反应：** 广告播出后的民意调查可能会显示它们是否改变了意见，或者只是增加了竞选季的噪音。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The White House says these ads inform the public.
segments.tr: 白宫表示这些广告告知了公众。

segments.src: Critics say they promote a politician at public expense.
segments.tr: 批评人士称它们是在用公众资金宣传政客。

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: 法律在这两者之间划出了真正的界限，但其应用取决于经常受到争议的内容、资金和时机的细节。

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.
segments.tr: 想要自行判断的读者可以看看广告实际上说了什么、谁支付了费用，以及它们是在解释一个项目还是主要在宣传个人。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes and reflects publicly discussed positions on all sides.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，反映了各方公开讨论的立场。

segments.src: It is not legal advice.*
segments.tr: 它不构成法律建议。*

hi.title: NFL खेलों के दौरान अभियान-शैली के विज्ञापन: व्हाइट हाउस द्वारा ट्रम्प का प्रचार जांच के दायरे में क्यों है

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: रविवार को फुटबॉल देखने वाले प्रशंसकों ने ट्रक विज्ञापनों और बीयर विज्ञापनों के सामान्य मिश्रण से परे कुछ देखा है: राष्ट्रपति ट्रम्प और उनके प्रशासन के रिकॉर्ड को बढ़ावा देने वाले पॉलिश किए गए विज्ञापन, जो NFL प्रसारणों और नेटवर्क समाचार कार्यक्रमों के दौरान प्रसारित हो रहे हैं।

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: व्हाइट हाउस ने इन विज्ञापनों का बचाव वैध सार्वजनिक संचार के रूप में किया है।

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: आलोचकों का कहना है कि वे अभियान विज्ञापनों की तरह दिखते और महसूस होते हैं, और उनका तर्क है कि यह अंतर मायने रखता है, खासकर जब मध्यावधि चुनाव केवल कुछ सप्ताह दूर हों।

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## बहस किस बात पर हो रही है

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: विवाद एक सरल प्रश्न पर केंद्रित है: सरकारी संदेश जनता को सूचित करना कब बंद करता है और एक राजनेता को बढ़ावा देना कब शुरू करता है?

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **व्हाइट हाउस का रुख:** अधिकारियों का कहना है कि विज्ञापन अमेरिकी जनता को नीतियों और उपलब्धियों के बारे में बताते हैं, और दोनों दलों के राष्ट्रपतियों ने हमेशा मतदाताओं के साथ संवाद करने के लिए कार्यालय के मंच का उपयोग किया है।

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **आलोचकों का रुख:** वॉचडॉग समूह, कुछ कानूनी विद्वान और राजनीतिक विरोधी कहते हैं कि विज्ञापन राष्ट्रपति पर व्यक्तिगत रूप से जोर देते हैं, अभियान की दृश्य भाषा का उपयोग करते हैं, और सबसे महंगे और सबसे अधिक देखे जाने वाले टेलीविजन स्लॉट में चलते हैं। उनकी दृष्टि में, यह सार्वजनिक जानकारी से अधिक राजनीतिक अनुनय जैसा दिखता है।

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्ष एक बिंदु पर सहमत हैं: विज्ञापन बहुत बड़े दर्शकों तक पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: NFL खेल उन कुछ शेष लाइव कार्यक्रमों में से हैं जो एक बार में करोड़ों दर्शकों को आकर्षित करते हैं, यही कारण है कि हर तरह के विज्ञापनदाता उन स्लॉट के लिए प्रीमियम भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## करदाता-वित्त पोषित संदेशों पर नियम

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: संघीय कानून और लंबे समय से चली आ रही मार्गदर्शन नीतियां इस बात पर सीमाएं लगाती हैं कि जनता के साथ संवाद करने के लिए सरकारी धन का उपयोग कैसे किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: विवरण समझने योग्य हैं, क्योंकि राजनीतिक तर्कों में अक्सर इन्हें गलत तरीके से प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **प्रचार और दुष्प्रचार प्रतिबंध।** कांग्रेस ने दशकों से विनियोग कानूनों में प्रावधान जोड़े हैं जो कांग्रेस द्वारा अधिकृत नहीं किए गए "प्रचार या दुष्प्रचार" उद्देश्यों के लिए संघीय धन के उपयोग पर रोक लगाते हैं।

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: सरकारी जवाबदेही कार्यालय (GAO), जो ऐसे सवालों की समीक्षा करता है, ने आम तौर पर इसकी व्याख्या गुप्त दुष्प्रचार, विशुद्ध रूप से पक्षपाती संदेश, और अधिकारियों द्वारा आत्म-प्रशंसा को कवर करने के लिए की है।

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **हच एक्ट।** यह कानून अधिकांश संघीय कर्मचारियों द्वारा राजनीतिक गतिविधि को प्रतिबंधित करता है।

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: यह राष्ट्रपति पद की तुलना में व्यक्तिगत कर्मचारियों पर अधिक सीधे लागू होता है, क्योंकि राष्ट्रपति और उपराष्ट्रपति इसके मुख्य प्रावधानों से काफी हद तक मुक्त हैं।

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: वह छूट एक कारण है कि व्हाइट हाउस संचार के आसपास प्रवर्तन के सवाल जटिल हैं।

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **वैध सरकारी जानकारी।** एजेंसियों को कार्यक्रमों, लाभों, सुरक्षा जानकारी और समय सीमा के बारे में जनता को सूचित करने की अनुमति है, और अक्सर इसकी आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: जन सेवा घोषणाएं आम हैं और ज्यादातर निर्विवाद हैं।

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: ग्रे क्षेत्र तब दिखाई देता है जब कोई संदेश किसी कार्यक्रम या सेवा के बजाय किसी नामित अधिकारी और उनके व्यक्तिगत श्रेय पर केंद्रित होता है।

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **कौन भुगतान करता है यह मायने रखता है।** कुछ विज्ञापन करदाताओं के बजाय एक राजनीतिक समिति या संबद्ध बाहरी समूह द्वारा वित्त पोषित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: यदि ऐसा है, तो विनियोग प्रतिबंध उसी तरह लागू नहीं होंगे, हालांकि अभियान वित्त और प्रकटीकरण नियम लागू होंगे।

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: वित्त पोषण के स्रोत का निर्धारण अक्सर किसी भी वैध समीक्षा में पहला कदम होता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## रेखा खींचना कठिन क्यों है

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: समीक्षक आमतौर पर कुछ कारकों को देखते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **सामग्री:** क्या विज्ञापन किसी कार्यक्रम और उसका उपयोग कैसे करें, इसका वर्णन करता है, या यह मुख्य रूप से किसी व्यक्ति की प्रशंसा करता है?

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **स्वर और कल्पना:** क्या प्रस्तुति सूचनात्मक है, या यह अभियान-शैली के संगीत, नारों और विरोधियों के साथ तुलना का उपयोग करती है?

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **समय:** क्या विज्ञापन चुनाव के करीब चलता है, और क्या यह उम्मीदवारों या मतपत्र विकल्पों का उल्लेख करता है?

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **नियुक्ति:** क्या दर्शकों को संदेश के लिए उनकी उपयोगिता के लिए लक्षित किया गया है, या उनके राजनीतिक मूल्य के लिए?

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **वित्त पोषण:** एयरटाइम और उत्पादन के लिए किसने भुगतान किया?

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: कोई भी एक कारक निर्णायक नहीं है।

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: दोनों दलों के पिछले प्रशासनों ने वकालत-शैली के सरकारी संचार के बारे में शिकायतों का सामना किया है, और प्रवर्तन ऐतिहासिक रूप से सीमित रहा है।

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: GAO की राय का वजन होता है, लेकिन वे हमेशा दंड के साथ नहीं आते हैं, और अदालतों ने शायद ही कभी हस्तक्षेप किया है।

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## मध्यावधि चुनाव से कुछ सप्ताह पहले इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.

es.title: Anuncios de estilo de campaña durante los partidos de la NFL: por qué la promoción de Trump por parte de la Casa Blanca está bajo escrutinio

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: Los aficionados al fútbol americano que sintonizan los domingos se han encontrado con algo más que la mezcla habitual de anuncios de camionetas y cerveza: spots pulidos que promocionan al presidente Trump y el historial de su administración, emitidos durante las transmisiones de la NFL y en los programas de noticias de las cadenas de televisión.

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: La Casa Blanca ha defendido los anuncios como comunicación pública legítima.

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: Los críticos dicen que se ven y se sienten como publicidad de campaña, y argumentan que la diferencia importa, especialmente con las elecciones de mitad de período a solo unas semanas de distancia.

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## Qué se está debatiendo

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: La disputa se centra en una pregunta sencilla: ¿cuándo deja la mensajería gubernamental de informar al público y comienza a promocionar a un político?

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **La postura de la Casa Blanca:** Los funcionarios dicen que los anuncios explican políticas y logros al público estadounidense, y que los presidentes de ambos partidos siempre han utilizado la plataforma del cargo para comunicarse con los votantes.

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **La postura de los críticos:** Los grupos de control, algunos juristas y opositores políticos dicen que los anuncios enfatizan al presidente personalmente, utilizan el lenguaje visual de una campaña y se emiten en los espacios televisivos más caros y más vistos. En su opinión, eso se parece más a la persuasión política que a la información pública.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: Ambas partes coinciden en un punto: los anuncios llegan a una audiencia muy grande.

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: Los partidos de la NFL se encuentran entre los pocos eventos en vivo que quedan que atraen a decenas de millones de espectadores a la vez, razón por la cual los anunciantes de todo tipo pagan una tarifa premium por esos espacios.

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## Las reglas sobre la mensajería financiada por los contribuyentes

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: La ley federal y las directrices de larga data imponen límites a la forma en que se puede utilizar el dinero del gobierno para comunicarse con el público.

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: Vale la pena entender los detalles, porque a menudo se tergiversan en los argumentos políticos.

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **Restricciones de publicidad y propaganda.** Desde hace décadas, el Congreso ha incorporado disposiciones a las leyes de asignaciones presupuestarias que prohíben el uso de fondos federales para fines de "publicidad o propaganda" no autorizados por el Congreso.

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: La Oficina de Rendición de Cuentas del Gobierno (GAO), que revisa estas cuestiones, ha interpretado generalmente que esto cubre la propaganda encubierta, la mensajería puramente partidista y el autoelogio por parte de los funcionarios.

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **La Ley Hatch.** Esta ley restringe la actividad política de la mayoría de los empleados federales.

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: Se aplica a los empleados individuales de manera más directa que a la propia presidencia, ya que el presidente y el vicepresidente están en gran medida exentos de sus disposiciones fundamentales.

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: Esa exención es una de las razones por las que las cuestiones de aplicación en torno a las comunicaciones de la Casa Blanca son complicadas.

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **Información gubernamental legítima.** Las agencias tienen permitido, y a menudo se les exige, informar al público sobre programas, beneficios, información de seguridad y plazos.

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: Los anuncios de servicio público son comunes y, en su mayoría, no generan controversia.

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: La zona gris aparece cuando un mensaje se centra en un funcionario con nombre propio y su mérito personal, en lugar de en un programa o servicio.

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **Quién paga importa.** Algunos de los anuncios pueden estar financiados por un comité político o un grupo externo aliado en lugar de por los contribuyentes.

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: Si es así, las restricciones de las asignaciones no se aplicarían de la misma manera, aunque sí lo harían las normas de financiación de campañas y divulgación.

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: Determinar la fuente de financiación suele ser el primer paso en cualquier revisión legítima.

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## Por qué es difícil trazar la línea

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: Los revisores suelen analizar un puñado de factores:

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **Contenido:** ¿El anuncio describe un programa y cómo utilizarlo, o elogia principalmente a una persona?

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **Tono e imágenes:** ¿La presentación es informativa o utiliza música de estilo de campaña, eslóganes y contraste con los oponentes?

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **Sincronización:** ¿Se emite el anuncio cerca de una elección y menciona candidatos u opciones de voto?

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **Ubicación:** ¿Se dirige a la audiencia por su utilidad para el mensaje o por su valor político?

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **Financiación:** ¿Quién pagó por el tiempo de emisión y la producción?

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: Ningún factor por sí solo es decisivo.

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: Las administraciones pasadas de ambos partidos se han enfrentado a quejas sobre comunicaciones gubernamentales de estilo de promoción, y la aplicación de la ley históricamente ha sido limitada.

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: Las opiniones de la GAO tienen peso, pero no siempre conllevan sanciones, y los tribunales rara vez han intervenido.

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Qué significa a semanas de las elecciones de mitad de período

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.
segments.tr: El momento amplifica la controversia.

segments.src: Midterm elections determine control of Congress, and the president's approval and visibility tend to shape how voters feel about candidates from the president's party, even when the president is not on the ballot.
segments.tr: Las elecciones de mitad de período determinan el control del Congreso, y la aprobación y visibilidad del presidente tienden a influir en cómo se sienten los votantes respecto a los candidatos del partido del presidente, incluso cuando el presidente no está en la boleta electoral.

segments.src: Supporters of the ads see a president speaking directly to the public and getting around media filters.
segments.tr: Los partidarios de los anuncios ven a un presidente que habla directamente al público y esquiva los filtros de los medios de comunicación.

segments.src: Opponents see an advantage that challengers and rival parties cannot match, since a government communications operation is not bound by the same fundraising limits as a campaign.
segments.tr: Los opositores ven una ventaja que los desafiantes y los partidos rivales no pueden igualar, ya que una operación de comunicaciones del gobierno no está sujeta a los mismos límites de recaudación de fondos que una campaña.

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: También hay una cuestión práctica de los medios de comunicación.

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: Las emisoras y las cadenas de televisión establecen sus propios estándares para aceptar publicidad política y de temas de interés, y muchas aplican una revisión adicional a los anuncios que tocan temas políticos controvertidos.

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: La forma en que se aplican esos estándares a los espacios patrocinados por el gobierno es un punto de discusión aparte.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **Divulgación de financiación:** Las declaraciones y los registros públicos pueden aclarar quién pagó los anuncios.

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **Solicitudes de supervisión:** Los miembros del Congreso o los grupos de control pueden pedir a la GAO o a los inspectores generales que revisen el gasto.

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **Decisiones de las emisoras:** Las cadenas y las ligas podrían aclarar cómo clasifican estos anuncios.

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **Respuesta de los votantes:** Las encuestas después de que se emitan los anuncios pueden mostrar si cambian las opiniones o simplemente se suman al ruido de la temporada de campaña.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En pocas palabras

segments.tr: La Casa Blanca dice que estos anuncios informan al público.

segments.tr: Los críticos dicen que promocionan a un político a expensas del erario público.

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: La ley establece una distinción real entre ambos, pero aplicarla depende de detalles de contenido, financiación y sincronización que a menudo se disputan.

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.

fr.title: Publicités de style électoral pendant les matchs de la NFL : pourquoi la promotion de Trump par la Maison-Blanche suscite des critiques

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: Les fans de football qui regardent les matchs le dimanche ont découvert autre chose que le mélange habituel de publicités pour des camions et de réclames pour la bière : des spots soignés faisant la promotion du président Trump et du bilan de son administration, diffusés pendant les retransmissions de la NFL et lors des journaux télévisés des grands réseaux.

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: La Maison-Blanche a défendu ces publicités en les qualifiant de communication publique légitime.

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: Les critiques affirment qu'elles ont l'apparence et la tonalité de publicités de campagne, et soutiennent que cette distinction est importante, en particulier à l'approche des élections de mi-mandat, qui n'ont lieu que dans quelques semaines.

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## Ce qui fait débat

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: Le différend s'articule autour d'une question simple : à quel moment la communication gouvernementale cesse-t-elle d'informer le public pour commencer à faire la promotion d'un homme politique ?

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **La position de la Maison-Blanche :** Des responsables affirment que ces publicités expliquent les politiques et les réalisations au public américain, et que les présidents de tous bords ont toujours utilisé la tribune de leur fonction pour communiquer avec les électeurs.

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **La position des critiques :** Des groupes de surveillance, certains juristes et des opposants politiques déclarent que ces publicités mettent personnellement en valeur le président, utilisent le langage visuel d'une campagne et sont diffusées aux heures de grande écoute les plus chères et les plus regardées. Selon eux, cela ressemble davantage à de la persuasion politique qu'à de l'information publique.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: Les deux parties s'accordent sur un point : ces publicités touchent un public très vaste.

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: Les matchs de la NFL comptent parmi les rares événements en direct qui attirent des dizaines de millions de téléspectateurs en même temps, raison pour laquelle les publicitaires de tous bords paient le prix fort pour ces espaces.

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## Les règles régissant la communication financée par les contribuables

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: La loi fédérale et des directives de longue date fixent des limites à l'utilisation de l'argent public pour communiquer avec le public.

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: Il est utile d'en comprendre les détails, car ils sont souvent mal interprétés dans les débats politiques.

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **Restrictions en matière de publicité et de propagande.** Le Congrès a, pendant des décennies, rattaché aux lois de crédits des dispositions interdisant l'utilisation de fonds fédéraux à des fins de "publicité ou de propagande" non autorisées par le Congrès.

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: Le Bureau de la responsabilité gouvernementale (GAO), qui examine ces questions, a généralement interprété cela comme englobant la propagande clandestine, la communication purement partisane et l'auto-glorification par des responsables.

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **La loi Hatch.** Cette loi restreint l'activité politique de la plupart des employés fédéraux.

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: Elle s'applique aux employés individuels plus directement qu'à la présidence elle-même, étant donné que le président et le vice-président sont largement exemptés de ses dispositions principales.

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: Cette exemption est l'une des raisons pour lesquelles les questions d'application concernant les communications de la Maison-Blanche sont complexes.

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **L'information gouvernementale légitime.** Les agences sont autorisées, et souvent tenues, d'informer le public sur les programmes, les prestations, les consignes de sécurité et les délais.

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: Les messages d'intérêt public sont courants et, pour la plupart, ne prêtent pas à controverse.

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: La zone grise apparaît lorsqu'un message est centré sur un responsable nommé et sur son mérite personnel plutôt que sur un programme ou un service.

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **L'origine du financement importe.** Certaines de ces publicités peuvent être financées par un comité politique ou un groupe extérieur allié plutôt que par les contribuables.

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi il est difficile de tracer la limite

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: Les examinateurs s'appuient généralement sur un ensemble de facteurs :

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **Le contenu :** l'annonce décrit-elle un programme et la manière de l'utiliser, ou fait-elle principalement l'éloge d'une personne ?

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **Le ton et l'imagerie :** la présentation est-elle informative, ou utilise-t-elle une musique, des slogans et des contrastes de style électoral avec les opposants ?

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **Le calendrier :** l'annonce est-elle diffusée à l'approche d'une élection, et mentionne-t-elle des candidats ou des choix de vote ?

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **Le placement :** le public est-il ciblé pour son utilité par rapport au message, ou pour sa valeur politique ?

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **Le financement :** qui a payé le temps d'antenne et la production ?

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: Aucun facteur pris isolément n'est décisif.

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: Les administrations précédentes de tous bords ont fait l'objet de plaintes concernant des communications gouvernementales de type militant, et l'application des règles a historiquement été limitée.

pt.title: Anúncios no Estilo de Campanha Durante os Jogos da NFL: Por Que a Promoção de Trump pela Casa Branca Está Gerando Escrutínio

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: Fãs de futebol americano que sintonizam aos domingos encontraram algo além da mistura habitual de comerciais de caminhonetes e anúncios de cerveja: inserções polidas promovendo o presidente Trump e o histórico de sua administração, veiculadas durante transmissões da NFL e em programas de notícias de redes de TV.

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: A Casa Branca defendeu os anúncios como comunicação pública legítima.

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: Críticos dizem que eles têm a aparência e a sensação de publicidade de campanha, e argumentam que a diferença importa, especialmente com as eleições de meio de mandato a poucas semanas de distância.

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## O Que Está Sendo Debatido

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: A disputa gira em torno de uma pergunta simples: quando a mensagem do governo deixa de informar o público e passa a promover um político?

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **A posição da Casa Branca:** Autoridades dizem que os anúncios explicam políticas e realizações ao público americano, e que presidentes de ambos os partidos sempre usaram a plataforma do cargo para se comunicar com os eleitores.

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **A posição dos críticos:** Grupos de fiscalização, alguns acadêmicos jurídicos e opositores políticos dizem que os anúncios enfatizam o presidente pessoalmente, usam a linguagem visual de uma campanha e são veiculados nos espaços televisivos mais caros e mais assistidos. Em sua visão, isso se assemelha mais à persuasão política do que à informação pública.

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: Ambos os lados concordam em um ponto: os anúncios atingem um público muito grande.

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: Os jogos da NFL estão entre os poucos eventos ao vivo restantes que atraem dezenas de milhões de espectadores de uma só vez, e é por isso que anunciantes de todos os tipos pagam caro por esses espaços.

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## As Regras sobre Mensagens Financiadas por Contribuintes

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: A lei federal e diretrizes de longa data estabelecem limites sobre como o dinheiro do governo pode ser usado para se comunicar com o público.

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: Vale a pena entender os detalhes, porque eles costumam ser mal interpretados em argumentos políticos.

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **Restrições de publicidade e propaganda.** O Congresso há décadas inclui disposições em leis de dotações orçamentárias proibindo o uso de fundos federais para fins de "publicidade ou propaganda" não autorizados pelo Congresso.

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: O Gabinete de Responsabilidade Governamental (GAO), que analisa essas questões, geralmente interpreta isso como abrangendo propaganda encoberta, mensagens puramente partidárias e autopromoção por autoridades.

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **A Lei Hatch.** Esta lei restringe a atividade política da maioria dos funcionários federais.

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: Ela se aplica a funcionários individuais de forma mais direta do que à própria Presidência, uma vez que o presidente e o vice-presidente estão amplamente isentos de suas disposições centrais.

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: Essa isenção é uma das razões pelas quais as questões de aplicação em torno das comunicações da Casa Branca são complicadas.

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **Informações governamentais legítimas.** As agências têm permissão, e muitas vezes a obrigação, de informar o público sobre programas, benefícios, informações de segurança e prazos.

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: Os anúncios de utilidade pública são comuns e majoritariamente incontroversos.

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: A zona cinzenta aparece quando uma mensagem se concentra em uma autoridade nomeada e em seu mérito pessoal, em vez de em um programa ou serviço.

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **Quem paga importa.** Alguns dos anúncios podem ser financiados por um comitê político ou grupo aliado externo em vez de pelos contribuintes.

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: Se for o caso, as restrições de dotações não se aplicariam da mesma forma, embora as regras de financiamento de campanha e divulgação se apliquem.

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: Determinar a fonte de financiamento costuma ser o primeiro passo em qualquer revisão legítima.

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## Por Que a Linha É Difícil de Traçar

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: Os avaliadores normalmente analisam alguns fatores:

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **Conteúdo:** O anúncio descreve um programa e como usá-lo, ou elogia principalmente uma pessoa?

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **Tom e imagens:** A apresentação é informativa, ou usa música estilo campanha, slogans e contraste com oponentes?

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **Cronograma:** O anúncio é veiculado perto de uma eleição e menciona candidatos ou escolhas de voto?

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **Veiculação:** O público é visado por sua utilidade para a mensagem ou por seu valor político?

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **Financiamento:** Quem pagou pelo tempo de transmissão e pela produção?

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: Nenhum fator isolado é decisivo.

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: Administrações anteriores de ambos os partidos enfrentaram reclamações sobre comunicações governamentais no estilo de advocacia, e a aplicação tem sido historicamente limitada.

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: As opiniões do GAO têm peso, mas nem sempre vêm acompanhadas de penalidades, e os tribunais raramente intervieram.

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## O Que Isso Significa Semanas Antes das Midterms

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.
segments.tr: O timing amplifica a controvérsia.

segments.src: Midterm elections determine control of Congress, and the president's approval and visibility tend to shape how voters feel about candidates from the president's party, even when the president is not on the ballot.
segments.tr: As eleições de meio de mandato determinam o controle do Congresso, e a aprovação e visibilidade do presidente tendem a moldar o que os eleitores sentem sobre os candidatos do partido do presidente, mesmo quando o presidente não está na cédula.

segments.src: Supporters of the ads see a president speaking directly to the public and getting around media filters.
segments.tr: Os apoiadores dos anúncios veem um presidente falando diretamente com o público e contornando os filtros da mídia.

segments.src: Opponents see an advantage that challengers and rival parties cannot match, since a government communications operation is not bound by the same fundraising limits as a campaign.
segments.tr: Os oponentes veem uma vantagem que desafiantes e partidos rivais não podem igualar, uma vez que uma operação de comunicação governamental não está vinculada aos mesmos limites de arrecadação de fundos que uma campanha.

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: Há também uma questão prática de mídia.

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: Emissoras e redes definem seus próprios padrões para aceitar publicidade política e de causas, e muitas aplicam uma revisão extra a anúncios que abordam tópicos políticos contestados.

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: Como esses padrões são aplicados a spots patrocinados pelo governo é um ponto de discussão separado.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar a Seguir

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **Divulgações de financiamento:** Registros e documentos públicos podem esclarecer quem pagou pelos anúncios.

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **Pedidos de supervisão:** Membros do Congresso ou grupos de fiscalização podem pedir ao GAO ou a inspetores gerais que revisem os gastos.

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **Decisões das emissoras:** Redes e ligas podem esclarecer como classificam esses anúncios.

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **Resposta dos eleitores:** Pesquisas após a veiculação dos anúncios podem mostrar se eles mudam opiniões ou simplesmente aumentam o ruído da temporada de campanha.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The White House says these ads inform the public.
segments.tr: A Casa Branca diz que esses anúncios informam o público.

segments.src: Critics say they promote a politician at public expense.
segments.tr: Críticos dizem que eles promovam um político às custas do público.

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: A lei estabelece uma distinção real entre os dois, mas aplicá-la depende de detalhes de conteúdo, financiamento e timing que costumam ser contestados.

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.
segments.tr: Leitores que quiserem julgar por si mesmos podem observar o que os anúncios realmente dizem, quem pagou por eles e se eles explicam um programa ou promovem principalmente uma pessoa.

ja.title: NFLの試合中のキャンペーン風広告：ホワイトハウスによるトランプ氏の宣伝が精査を受けている理由

segments.src: Football fans tuning in on Sundays have encountered something beyond the usual mix of truck commercials and beer ads: polished spots promoting President Trump and his administration's record, airing during NFL broadcasts and on network news programs.
segments.tr: 日曜日に観戦するフットボールファンは、通常のトラックのコマーシャルやビールの広告とは違うものに遭遇している。NFLの放送中やネットワークのニュース番組で、トランプ大統領とその政権の実績を宣伝する洗練されたスポットが放映されているのだ。

segments.src: The White House has defended the ads as legitimate public communication.
segments.tr: ホワイトハウスは、これらの広告を正当な公共のコミュニケーションとして擁護している。

segments.src: Critics say they look and feel like campaign advertising, and they argue that the difference matters, especially with the midterm elections only weeks away.
segments.tr: 批判派は、それらが選挙運動の広告のように見え、感じられると述べ、特に中間選挙まで数週間に迫る中、その違いが重要であると主張している。

segments.src: ## What Is Being Debated
segments.tr: ## 議論されていること

segments.src: The dispute centers on a simple question: when does government messaging stop informing the public and start promoting a politician?
segments.tr: この論争の中心にあるのは単純な疑問である。政府のメッセージは、いつから一般市民への情報提供をやめ、政治家の宣伝を始めるのか？

segments.src: - **The White House position:** Officials say the ads explain policies and achievements to the American public, and that presidents of both parties have always used the platform of the office to communicate with voters.
segments.tr: - **ホワイトハウスの立場：** 当局者は、広告は政策と実績をアメリカ国民に説明するものであり、双方の政党の大統領が有権者とコミュニケーションをとるために常に職務のプラットフォームを利用してきたと述べている。

segments.src: - **The critics' position:** Watchdog groups, some legal scholars and political opponents say the ads emphasize the president personally, use the visual language of a campaign, and run in the most expensive and most-watched television slots. In their view, that resembles political persuasion more than public information.
segments.tr: - **批判派の立場：** 監視団体、一部の法学者、政治的反対派は、これらの広告が大統領個人を強調し、選挙運動の視覚的言語を使用し、最も高価で最も視聴されている時間帯に放送されていると述べている。彼らの見解では、それは公共の情報よりも政治的説得に似ている。

segments.src: Both sides agree on one point: the ads reach a very large audience.
segments.tr: 双方とも1点については意見が一致している。これらの広告は非常に多くの聴衆に届くということだ。

segments.src: NFL games are among the few remaining live events that draw tens of millions of viewers at once, which is why advertisers of every kind pay a premium for those slots.
segments.tr: NFLの試合は、一度に数千万人の視聴者を引き付ける数少ないライブイベントの一つであり、あらゆる種類の広告主がそれらの枠に高い料金を支払うのはそのためである。

segments.src: ## The Rules on Taxpayer-Funded Messaging
segments.tr: ## 税金で資金提供されるメッセージに関する規則

segments.src: Federal law and long-standing guidance put limits on how government money can be used to communicate with the public.
segments.tr: 連邦法と長年のガイダンスは、公共とのコミュニケーションに政府の資金をどのように使用できるかについて制限を設けている。

segments.src: The details are worth understanding, because they are often misstated in political arguments.
segments.tr: 政治的議論の中で誤って伝えられることが多いため、その詳細は理解する価値がある。

segments.src: **Publicity and propaganda restrictions.** Congress has for decades attached provisions to appropriations laws barring the use of federal funds for "publicity or propaganda" purposes not authorized by Congress.
segments.tr: **宣伝およびプロパガンダの制限。** 議会は何十年もの間、議会によって承認されていない「宣伝またはプロパガンダ」目的での連邦資金の使用を禁止する規定を歳出法に付してきた。

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), which reviews such questions, has generally interpreted this to cover covert propaganda, purely partisan messaging, and self-aggrandizement by officials.
segments.tr: このような問題を審査する政府説明責任局（GAO）は、一般的にこれを隠れプロパガンダ、純粋に党派的なメッセージ、および当局者による自己誇示をカバーするものと解釈してきた。

segments.src: **The Hatch Act.** This law restricts political activity by most federal employees.
segments.tr: **ハッチ法。** この法律は、ほとんどの連邦職員による政治活動を制限している。

segments.src: It applies to individual employees more directly than to the presidency itself, since the president and vice president are largely exempt from its core provisions.
segments.tr: 大統領と副大統領はその主要な規定から大部分が免除されているため、大統領職自体よりも個々の職員に直接適用される。

segments.src: That exemption is one reason enforcement questions around White House communications are complicated.
segments.tr: その免除は、ホワイトハウスのコミュニケーションに関する執行の問題が複雑である理由の一つである。

segments.src: **Legitimate government information.** Agencies are allowed, and often required, to inform the public about programs, benefits, safety information and deadlines.
segments.tr: **正当な政府情報。** 機関は、プログラム、給付、安全情報、および締め切りについて一般市民に知らせることが許可されており、多くの場合要求されている。

segments.src: Public service announcements are common and mostly uncontroversial.
segments.tr: 公共広告は一般的であり、ほとんど物議を醸さない。

segments.src: The gray area appears when a message centers on a named official and their personal credit rather than on a program or service.
segments.tr: グレーゾーンが現れるのは、メッセージがプログラムやサービスではなく、名指しされた当局者とその個人的な功績を中心としているときである。

segments.src: **Who pays matters.** Some of the ads may be funded by a political committee or allied outside group instead of by taxpayers.
segments.tr: **誰が支払うかが重要である。** 広告の一部は、納税者ではなく政治委員会や同盟関係にある外部グループによって資金提供されている可能性がある。

segments.src: If so, the appropriations restrictions would not apply in the same way, though campaign finance and disclosure rules would.
segments.tr: もしそうなら、選挙運動の資金と開示の規則は適用されるものの、歳出の制限は同じようには適用されない。

segments.src: Determining the funding source is often the first step in any legitimate review.
segments.tr: 資金源を特定することは、正当な審査においてしばしば最初のステップとなる。

segments.src: ## Why the Line Is Hard to Draw
segments.tr: ## 境界線を引くのが難しい理由

segments.src: Reviewers typically look at a handful of factors:
segments.tr: 審査官は通常、いくつかの要因を考慮する：

segments.src: 1. **Content:** Does the ad describe a program and how to use it, or does it mainly praise a person?
segments.tr: 1. **内容：** 広告はプログラムとその使用方法を説明しているか、それとも主に人を賞賛しているか？

segments.src: 2. **Tone and imagery:** Is the presentation informational, or does it use campaign-style music, slogans and contrast with opponents?
segments.tr: 2. **トーンとイメージ：** プレゼンテーションは情報提供型か、それともキャンペーン風の音楽、スローガン、反対派との対比を使用しているか？

segments.src: 3. **Timing:** Does the ad run close to an election, and does it mention candidates or ballot choices?
segments.tr: 3. **タイミング：** 広告は選挙の近くで放送されているか、候補者や投票の選択肢に言及しているか？

segments.src: 4. **Placement:** Is the audience targeted for its usefulness to the message, or for its political value?
segments.tr: 4. **配置：** 聴衆はメッセージへの有用性のためにターゲットにされているのか、それとも政治的価値のためにターゲットにされているのか？

segments.src: 5. **Funding:** Who paid for the airtime and production?
segments.tr: 5. **資金調達：** 放送時間と制作費を支払ったのは誰か？

segments.src: No single factor is decisive.
segments.tr: 単一の要因が決定的なものとなるわけではない。

segments.src: Past administrations from both parties have faced complaints about advocacy-style government communications, and enforcement has historically been limited.
segments.tr: 双方の党の過去の政権は、アドボカシー型の政府コミュニケーションに関する苦情に直面しており、執行は歴史的に限られてきた。

segments.src: GAO opinions carry weight, but they do not always come with penalties, and courts have rarely stepped in.
segments.tr: GAOの意見には重みがあるが、必ずしもペナルティが伴うわけではなく、裁判所が介入することはめったにない。

segments.src: ## What It Means Weeks Before the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 中間選挙の数週間前が意味するもの

segments.src: The timing amplifies the controversy.
segments.tr: タイミングが論争を増幅させている。

segments.src: Midterm elections determine control of Congress, and the president's approval and visibility tend to shape how voters feel about candidates from the president's party, even when the president is not on the ballot.
segments.tr: 中間選挙は議会の支配権を決定し、大統領が投票用紙に載っていない場合でも、大統領の承認と可視性は、有権者が大統領の党の候補者に対してどのように感じるかを形作る傾向がある。

segments.src: Supporters of the ads see a president speaking directly to the public and getting around media filters.
segments.tr: 広告の支持者は、大統領が直接国民に語りかけ、メディアのフィルターを回避していると見なしている。

segments.src: Opponents see an advantage that challengers and rival parties cannot match, since a government communications operation is not bound by the same fundraising limits as a campaign.
segments.tr: 反対派は、政府のコミュニケーション活動が選挙運動と同じ資金集めの制限に縛られていないため、チャレンジャーやライバル政党が匹敵できない優位性を見出している。

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: 実用的なメディアの問題もある。

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: 放送局とネットワークは政治および問題広告を受け入れるための独自の基準を設定しており、多くは争われている政治的トピックに触れる広告に追加の審査を適用している。

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: それらの基準が政府主催のスポットにどのように適用されるかは、別の議論のポイントである。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべきこと

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **資金調達の開示：** 届出や公開記録により、広告の費用を支払った人が明確になる可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **監督の要請：** 議員や監視団体は、GAOや監査官に支出の審査を依頼するかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **放送局の決定：** ネットワークやリーグは、これらの広告をどのように分類するかを明確にする可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **有権者の反応：** 広告放映後の世論調査は、意見を変えるか、それとも単に選挙シーズンの雑音を増やすかを示すかもしれない。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The White House says these ads inform the public.
segments.tr: ホワイトハウスは、これらの広告が一般市民に知らせていると述べている。

segments.src: Critics say they promote a politician at public expense.
segments.tr: 批判派は、それらが公費で政治家を宣伝していると述べている。

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: 法律は両者の間に実際の区別を描いているが、それを適用することは、しばしば異議が唱えられる内容、資金調達、およびタイミングの詳細に依存している。

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.
segments.tr: 自分で判断したい読者は、広告が実際に何を言っているのか、誰がその費用を支払ったのか、そしてそれらがプログラムを説明しているのか、それとも主に人を宣伝しているのかを見ることができる。

segments.tr: Gegner sehen einen Vorteil, den Herausforderer und rivalisierende Parteien nicht ausgleichen können, da eine staatliche Kommunikationsoperation nicht an dieselben Fundraising-Beschränkungen gebunden ist wie ein Wahlkampf.

segments.src: There is also a practical media question.
segments.tr: Es gibt auch eine praktische mediale Frage.

segments.src: Broadcasters and networks set their own standards for accepting political and issue advertising, and many apply extra review to ads that touch on contested political topics.
segments.tr: Sender und Netzwerke legen ihre eigenen Standards für die Annahme von politischer Werbung und Themenwerbung fest, und viele unterziehen Anzeigen, die umstrittene politische Themen berühren, einer zusätzlichen Prüfung.

segments.src: How those standards are applied to government-sponsored spots is a separate point of discussion.
segments.tr: Wie diese Standards auf staatlich geförderte Spots angewendet werden, ist ein separater Diskussionspunkt.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu beobachten ist

segments.src: - **Funding disclosures:** Filings and public records may clarify who paid for the ads.
segments.tr: - **Finanzierungsoffenlegungen:** Einreichungen und öffentliche Aufzeichnungen könnten klären, wer für die Anzeigen bezahlt hat.

segments.src: - **Oversight requests:** Members of Congress or watchdog groups may ask GAO or inspectors general to review the spending.
segments.tr: - **Aufsichtsanfragen:** Kongressabgeordnete oder Beobachtergruppen könnten das GAO oder Generalinspekteure bitten, die Ausgaben zu überprüfen.

segments.src: - **Broadcaster decisions:** Networks and leagues could clarify how they classify these ads.
segments.tr: - **Entscheidungen der Sender:** Netzwerke und Ligen könnten klarstellen, wie sie diese Anzeigen klassifizieren.

segments.src: - **Voter response:** Polling after the ads run may show whether they change opinions, or simply add to the noise of the campaign season.
segments.tr: - **Reaktion der Wähler:** Umfragen nach der Ausstrahlung der Anzeigen könnten zeigen, ob sie Meinungen ändern oder lediglich zum Lärm der Wahlkampfsaison beitragen.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The White House says these ads inform the public.
segments.tr: Das Weiße Haus sagt, diese Anzeigen informierten die Öffentlichkeit.

segments.src: Critics say they promote a politician at public expense.
segments.tr: Kritiker sagen, sie bewerben einen Politiker auf Kosten der Öffentlichkeit.

segments.src: The law draws a real distinction between the two, but applying it depends on details of content, funding and timing that are often disputed.
segments.tr: Das Gesetz zieht eine klare Grenze zwischen beidem, aber die Anwendung hängt von Details zu Inhalt, Finanzierung und Zeitpunkt ab, die oft umstritten sind.

segments.src: Readers who want to judge for themselves can look at what the ads actually say, who paid for them, and whether they explain a program or mainly promote a person.
segments.tr: Leser, die sich ein eigenes Urteil bilden wollen, können darauf achten, was die Anzeigen tatsächlich sagen, wer für sie bezahlt hat und ob sie ein Programm erklären oder hauptsächlich eine Person bewerben.
